desc:
🇮🇩 THE INDONESIA UPDATE IS HERE!
• NEW classroom: Sekolah Nusantara. Earn it FREE with Kupon Jajan until Nov 6!
• 9 Indonesian foods... and the Mythic DURIAN. It smells so strong the teacher notices without looking!
• SMA and SD school uniforms
• The whole game now speaks Bahasa Indonesia
• NEW badges, earned just by playing

🍱 Eat your lunch during class... without getting caught!
Eat while the teacher writes on the board. When he coughs and turns around, HIDE your food behind your book. Get caught and it's a short detention, but you keep your food.

⭐ Finish your lunchbox for a better grade and more money. 37 foods in six rarities, up to the Mythic Lobster. Unlock upgrades, plates, desks and classrooms.

👫 Every friend in your server adds +10% money (up to +30%). Invite a friend and you both get a bonus!
💎 Premium: +20% money per bite and a free Lucky Lunchbox every day.

🎃 Halloween until Nov 7: 15 treats win the Ghost Lobster, 40 the Haunted Academy!
